verdict.rationale: NetHunt's own marketing pages claim trigger-based workflow automations that run without manual action: they launch actions on field changes or user activity, move pipeline stages on trigger events, and capture and route leads automatically. The evidence is only short marketing claims, with no detail on how these workflows are built or how far they go. missing for 10: recurring/scheduled (time-based) background runs, AI-driven or agentic autonomous execution, in-depth workflow builder documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Launch automated actions based on any change in Sales CRM fields or user activity.
Adjust stages of the pipeline based on any trigger event.
Automatically capture and route leads to sales managers for faster follow-up.
Automate tasks and get alerts for key updates to stay on track.
